feature_name: Replace direct dependencies with imports in ak-common
description: Update the ak-common package to use imports for accessing shared functionality instead of direct dependencies where possible. This will improve code organization and reduce coupling between modules within the package.
functional_requirements: Replace direct references to other modules with proper imports in the arbiter module
Update the config module to use imports for accessing shared functionality
Ensure all functionality remains unchanged while using the import-based approach
Maintain existing public API interfaces during the refactoring
